verdict.rationale: Independent production users confirm Pydantic AI provides Agent.iter() and streaming primitives for surfacing agent steps. However, they also say that structured events, reconnection and history must be hand-wired with a lot of glue. A past report that some models wouldn't stream was described as eventually resolved, so it is not a current contradiction. The docs only say the agent can run behind a web frontend or a browser chat server, without documenting token or event streaming directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of token streaming and tool-call/step event streams, built-in UI event protocol/transport (reconnection, structured events), and evidence of consistent streaming across all providers.
